initial_receipt.explanation: The execution is faulty because the upstream provenance handoff is not in demand-descending rank order. The top-level corpus is demand-descending from n06-r01 score 9 through n06-r08 score 3, but Job 2 received evidence_sources ranked n06-r08, n06-r07, n06-r06, n06-r04, n06-r05, n06-r03, n06-r02, n06-r01. Job 2 then preserved that upstream provenance order in its priorities, including unsupported records first, so the visible downstream behavior follows its supplied handoff. The evidence supports localizing the fault to the upstream job that produced the incorrect evidence_sources order, but it does not expose an exact function name.
